title: A layer's track shows only what is animated, and you add or remove animated properties directly
goal: Adding a key to a clip should not fill its track with a row for every property that could be animated. Only properties that actually have keys appear. Picking a property row and pressing Delete stops animating it (keys removed, value left where it is at the playhead). Adding one back is direct: right-click the clip's key line for an Animate menu of properties, or change a value while the playhead is on a key and that property joins the animation automatically.
notes:
User's words (2026-10-12): "I don't really see the point of adding a 3d pane just to show the rotation values. I think when we move or change transitions, we can show a small toolbar like overlay which shows the transform values for typing things in. But doing some other operation or changing the tool makes the transform overlay disappear. On the overlay there should be a reset button to reset to defaults. Also similarly, for when I have a keyframe and click the opacity dot, I want the same overlay to appear to tweak the opacity. Also editing the graph of a particular item like scale is really hard. I can right click on the scale, say show graph, but then when the graph is there, how do I add points on it? I click on the line, doesn't add a point, i can select a point but then if I have 2 points, I can't select the line in between. I want to be able to easily create nice transitions by adding points, selecting the segments between them, right clicking and changing their easing, etc. I need the ia to be consistent across the properties. When I add a 'key' to a video, it adds all of the animatable properties below it. I really wish there was a more scalable solution to the ux here, because we really should only show the properties being animated. And, if we want to clear one of them, i should be able to select one of the rows and hit delete to remove the whole property from being animated. but there should be a way to add it back. like maybe the keyframe line should be selectable and right clicked to animate a variety of things. or I can click it, tweak something (like transform) and the options are automatically added to that keyframe."

Five tasks, in order: the design (mocks), then the transform overlay, the key value overlay, the graph editor, and only-animated-properties with auto-key. Code pointers (read, not run): the 3D section is Space3DInspector (Sources/Photonz/Space3DInspector.swift, shown at InspectorPanel.swift:1526) with EditorState+Space3D.swift; key lanes and the graph toggle are KeyLanesView.swift (segments at :270, lane menus :156, :213, :423) and EditorState+KeyLanes.swift (:283 'Show Graph'); Add Key on a clip is EditorState+TimelineMenus.swift:199 and per property EditorState+PropertyKeys.swift:177 addKeyHere; the property strip is MotionStripView.swift. The shared curve list is EasingCurve (PhotonzCore/LayerMotion.swift) with Draw a Curve, and CurveRow from every-transition-can-be-picked-from-presets-and. Memory rules: one purpose per area (the IA contract in docs/design/mocks/shared/UX-PATTERNS.md decides placement), mocks are the floor, legible text, no em dashes in UI copy. This is step 5 of 5.
acceptance: Reproduce first at Next defaults: Add Key on a recording and on a text layer; record which rows appear
Built to docs/design/mocks/pages/video-animate.html and the answer on its card about when a change becomes a key
A layer's track (and the motion strip) lists only properties that have at least one key; the clip's summary key line shows the union of their keys
Picking a property row and pressing Delete removes all of that property's keys in one undo step and its row disappears; the property keeps the value it had at the playhead

The summary key line is pickable; right-click on it (or on a key on it) offers Animate > (every animatable property not yet animated, grouped like the panel: Transform, 3D, Look, Effects), which adds a key at the playhead for that property and its row

Auto-key: when the layer already has keys and the playhead is on a key moment (or the person has turned on a record/auto-key switch, if the mock adds one), changing any property (by the transform overlay, a handle, or the panel) adds a key for it there and its row appears; the mock decides whether auto-key is always on with keys present or a switch, and the panel shows which

Add Key on a clip with no keys puts one hollow key moment on the clip's key line and adds no rows; properties join it when they change (the mock's answer; needs a key moment with nothing keyed in the model)
Existing documents open with only their keyed properties showing
A walk adds a key, checks only keyed rows show, deletes the scale row, re-adds scale from the key line's Animate menu, and nudges the layer at a key to see Position added automatically
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
